subject: Post-call: Bytescale integration + intermittent 5xx on embeddings/reranker
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Torres <samantha@bytescale.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (SDK setup + 5xx repro)

Thanks for the call earlier — good to meet the ByteScale integration team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you unblocked on embeddings/rerank in production:

- Observed behavior (from your notes): intermittent 502/503 responses from /v1/embeddings and the reranker endpoint during high-concurrency spikes.
- Suspected vectors: short client timeout, large/payload-encoded requests, or an SDK edge-case when payloads exceed chunking thresholds.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Can you attach a small (sanitized) request payload that reproduces a failing call? ideally <= 2 requests but that reproduce the 502.
2) Confirm which SDK version you’re on (pip package name + version or npm).
3) Share a short excerpt from the client-side logs around the failure (request id if available).

What we’ll do:
- Loop in Dev (cc’d) to attempt a repro against our staging endpoints and check for known SDK header/content-length issues.
- Recommend bumping client timeouts temporarily to 30s for embeddings/rerank while we investigate.

Proposed timeline: Dev will try a repro today/tomorrow and we’ll aim to have a mitigation (SDK patch or config change) in 48 hours. If you can share the payload + logs as attachments, that’ll speed things up.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate engineering time.

—
Marcus Lin

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (SDK setup + 5xx repro)

Thanks Marcus — attaching the logs and a sanitized request we used when the 502 happened. Details:
- SDK: python-redwood v0.9.1 (installed via pip)
- Observed client timeout: 2s (we tuned this for latency) which may be aggressive for larger inputs
- Request id we saw in server response headers: req_6a8f2b9

Attachments: bytescale-502-snippet.log (contains the timestamps and the server 502 stack summary), sdk-request-sample.json (sanitized, includes an embeddings call then reranker call).

We see the failure roughly 2–3x/day, typically under burst traffic when multiple requests with long text go out. Happy to open a shared endpoint to reproduce.

—
Samantha Torres

samantha@bytescale.com
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Torres <samantha@bytescale.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 19:48:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (SDK setup + 5xx repro)

Thanks for the artifacts — quick engineering read: the log excerpt + SDK version point to two likely causes:

1) Client timeout too low — 2s will cause aborted upstream requests during tokenization + KV cache warm-up for long inputs. Recommend 30s while we triage.
2) SDK 0.9.1 has a rare bug where chunked/streamed request bodies omit Content-Length under certain session-reuse conditions; some load balancers upstream respond with 502/503 when Content-Length is absent. We patched this in 0.9.3.

Short repro steps I’ll run against staging:
- pip install --upgrade python-redwood==0.9.3
- Use the sample payload (sdk-request-sample.json) and replay via curl and the SDK to confirm behavior. Example curl (direct REST):
  curl -v -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @sdk-request-sample.json --max-time 30

If I can reproduce, next steps: either a quick patch release for 0.9.2/0.9.3 or a server-side mitigation to accept chunked bodies. To help us reproduce, can you also: 
- Confirm the exact request id for one failing request (you sent req_6a8f2b9 — do you have surrounding trace ids?), and
- If possible, share the client-side HTTP debug log (-v output) for the failing call.

I’ll start the repro now and update this thread with results.

—
Dev Patel

dev_patel@redwood.com

- We also see the reranker call immediately following the embeddings call in the same session — both failed.
- Payload size: ~1.2MB (base64-encoded artifacts inside the JSON for additional metadata).

We can temporarily flip timeouts to 30s on our side; would be great if you can repro against staging with our sample. If it helps, we can open a narrow IP allowlist for you to hit our environment directly.
